entities.name: A0L8Q3
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A0L8Q3 from Magnetococcus marinus; dihydroxy-acid dehydratase, EC 4.2.1.9.
Sequence length 621 aa; estimated mass 66.3 kDa and theoretical pI 5.62.
Annotated as homodimer; cytosolic localization is a GO annotation with inferred evidence.

entities.name: DHA dehydration
observations: Catalyzes dehydration of 2,3-dihydroxyisovalerate to 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate plus water and of 2,3-dihydroxy-3-methylvalerate to 3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate plus water; EC 4.2.1.9.

entities.name: [2Fe-2S] cluster
observations: Annotated Lewis-acid cofactor; one cluster binds per protein subunit.

entities.name: Magnesium ion
observations: Mg2+ is listed as a cofactor.

entities.name: Branched-chain amino acids
observations: Functions in L-valine and L-isoleucine biosynthesis; the enzyme catalyzes the penultimate precursor-forming dehydration step for both.
